text:
elaine_cs: FYI AcmeCorp (50 seats) wants to close this week. Procurement insists on PO + vendor code but finance said credit card is possible if they accept the 2% fee. Need to confirm path and who drives signatures. cc @mike_acct @jordan_legal

mike_acct: I'll take procurement. Reached out to Melissa for PO number and exact vendor code. Will update in ~12-18h.

jordan_legal: Legal happy with pricing. They requested 9-month term instead of 12 1pro rata. Fine if we preserve auto-renew. Also need to check buyer's security addendum ask.

sophia_fin: If CC chosen, we still require a PO that notes "paid by credit card" for our records. If PO/net30 and EU entity, we need invoice-splitting approval. CC faster for activation.

tom_success: Buyer portal enforces 3 approvers (procurement/legal/finance). They can do CC but prefer PO. Scheduling a 15-min signoff call tomorrow 10am PT to finalize.

elaine_cs: Quick decision tree: 1) CC -> send DocuSign to finance lead, go-live same day. 2) PO -> wait 48-72h for procurement, may delay activation. Which does buyer prefer? Tom, can you confirm on call?

jordan_legal: Also flag: buyer asked for a short security addendum. Ask if SOC2 attestation is sufficient or if they will upload their draft.

mike_acct: Melissa replied: vendor code VC-9987 for US billing, VC-RE-EU-01 for EU. She's OK to generate PO once we send SOW + billing entity.

sophia_fin: Confirmed vendor code mapping. If they choose EU billing, include VAT ID and use VC-RE-EU-01 or invoice will route to wrong entity.

esign-bot: Draft envelope ready: Acme_2855009999_SOW. Waiting for final SOW attachment. Link: https://docusign.example/urn:acme_2855009999

tom_success: Invite sent for 10am PT. I'll capture the buyer's preference live and post final path here. If PO chosen, Mike will drive PO submission; if CC chosen, I'll trigger DocuSign and onboarding checklist.

elaine_cs: Thanks team. Goal = signatures by Friday EOD. If blocked, escalate here. :thumbsup:
